from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseRecord(BaseModel):
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document (e.g., 《判决文书 1》)")
    identified_cause: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) identified from the document content, matching the provided task list if possible")
    supporting_facts: str | None = Field(description="Brief text or key facts from the document that justify the identified cause of action")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[CaseRecord]
